deductions: Clarity: the opening metadata runs together at “Stand 76 MCEC, Melbourne 1 goal,” slowing a first read.
Tightness and organisation: the brief repeats the next-step instruction in “Conversation path” and “Before the visitor leaves.”
Actionability: “Ask Eerin or Gajan when they are available” leaves the immediate Peplink path incomplete; section 02 supplies the fallback.
Clarity: “category-level line” is editorial language that a rep may have to interpret.
Actionability: “Welcome channel partners as guests” gives no prompt for identifying when a specialist should join.
Continuity: “The confirmed list will appear in ‘Products and demonstrations’ below” points to a section that currently contains only an approval instruction.
Clarity: “on-site networking capability” may need plainer language for a quick stand briefing.
Actionability: “when the need is clear” leaves the threshold for bringing in a product specialist slightly subjective.
Clarity: “appropriate M2M Zoho CRM” assumes the reader knows which CRM receives the action.
Tightness and organisation: the action, owner and timing instruction appears in both “Agree the next step” and “Follow-up timing.”
Actionability: “record the reason” when no action is agreed does not say where in the lead record to put it.
Clarity: “practice QR code from the organiser's setup email” assumes the reader can recognise the correct code without a label or example.
Tightness and organisation: “Press SUBMIT” appears in both “The save rule” and “At the stand”; the repetition is useful but costs some space.

overall_findings: All five scored sections meet the 95 threshold in every dimension.
The repeated next-step and SUBMIT instructions reinforce the workflow; the brief and section 03 have the clearest opportunities to trim duplication.
No scored section contains a named customer or project, an unapproved count or outcome, a contradiction of the confidentiality rule, or a broken lead-save instruction.
Section 05 was excluded from scoring. Its live roster and event times were not supplied, so their preservation cannot be assessed from this text.
